title: Secure Haystack Cipher Construction
summary: No Haystack cipher is clearly known to achieve both IND-CPA and IND-CCA security; constructing one remains an open milestone that appears plausible with available tools.

formal_statement.body: Construct a secure Haystack cipher, modeled as a symmetric-encryption formulation of a white-box countermeasure, that achieves both chosen-plaintext ($\mathrm{IND\text{-}CPA}$) and chosen-ciphertext ($\mathrm{IND\text{-}CCA}$) security. These notions correspond closely to resistance against computational trace-based attacks and fault-injection attacks in the white-box model, respectively. No construction is currently clearly known to meet this minimum requirement, although achieving it appears plausible with available tools.

scope.domain: Haystack ciphers modeling white-box countermeasures as symmetric-encryption schemes.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a secure Haystack cipher that achieves both IND-CPA and IND-CCA security.
